amends.nature: WORDING CORRECTION ONLY — the permutation mechanism is UNCHANGED

CORRECTION_1_EARLY_CLOSE_MASS.RETRACTED_WORDING: 'the residual pressure is ANTI-conservative and is bounded by the 0.805% share'
why_retracted: an episode-mass share cannot bound a Type-I error distortion
it cannot bound a max-stat tail distortion
the median is NONLINEAR, so mass share does not translate into statistic distortion
claims differ in exposure: a SPECIFIC claim's EARLY_CLOSE share may be far above the aggregate

CORRECT_STATEMENT.measure: EARLY_CLOSE non-randomised episode mass = 23,780 / 2,952,695 = 0.805% of aggregate DEV opening-hour mass
CORRECT_STATEMENT.what_it_quantifies: the amount of episode mass held FIXED

why_not_even_the_direction: EARLY_CLOSE identity means the inference is CONDITIONAL on those fixed blocks
the early-close X-Y alignment is neither broken nor randomised — it is carried identically into every null draw
an apparent association arising only from those days therefore persists in the null too, which often REDUCES significance rather than inflating it
but median nonlinearities preclude any general directional theorem
CORRECTION_1_EARLY_CLOSE_MASS.REQUIRED_DIAGNOSTIC: report the PER-CLAIM EARLY_CLOSE share of positive and evaluable episodes; the aggregate 0.805% must not stand in for the claim-level figure

CORRECTION_2_ASSUMPTION_NAMING.what_was_actually_dropped: GLOBAL_DATE_EXCHANGEABILITY — the new null no longer relies on it
CORRECTION_2_ASSUMPTION_NAMING.precise_content: within each calendar year-month, the FULL_REGULAR Y-block sequence is treated as admissible under uniform CYCLIC ROTATIONS; i.e. the within-month cyclic alignment of X and Y is treated as randomisable under H0
CORRECTION_2_ASSUMPTION_NAMING.what_it_preserves: Y's internal within-month ordering under rotation
CORRECTION_2_ASSUMPTION_NAMING.status: an ASSUMPTION — narrower than the parent's, but still an assumption
CORRECTION_2_ASSUMPTION_NAMING.the_smoke_cannot_prove_it: a synthetic-Y smoke can only verify CORRECT IMPLEMENTATION of this contract; it can never establish that the contract holds of real data

MECHANISM_UNCHANGED.FULL_REGULAR: one uniform cyclic offset per calendar year-month per draw, shared across all securities, all 3 position pairs, all 20,751 claims
MECHANISM_UNCHANGED.explicit: no permutation, map, guard or statistic is altered by this amendment

STANDING_LESSON.class: a measured QUANTITY was silently promoted into a BOUND on a different quantity
STANDING_LESSON.rule: a share, count or rate may be reported as what it measures; converting it into a bound on an inferential error requires a derivation, not an adjacency
